title: Speeding up the Local C++ Development Cycle with Header Substitution
problem: C++ header inclusion significantly increases compilation time, but forward declarations have complex, non-obvious rules. Forward declaring methods and lambda-taking functions is impossible, limiting optimization opportunities.
motivation: C++ compilation time is critical bottleneck in development cycles, especially in large codebases. Reducing build time directly improves developer productivity across embedded and high-performance computing domains.
method: Header Substitution automatically detects forward declaration opportunities to replace header includes. Uses LLVM-based tool Yalla to transform includes into forward declarations. For methods and lambda-parameter functions, introduces function wrappers as alternative approach, guided by profitability analysis.
key_novelty: Automated detection of forward declaration opportunities with wrapper-based solutions for previously unhandleable cases (methods, lambdas).
contributions: Function wrapper technique for methods and lambda-parameter functions
Up to 24.5× speedup in C++ file compilation
limitations: Applicability to template-heavy modern C++ code not discussed; limitations of wrapper approach not detailed.
primary_theme: Automated header substitution for faster C++ builds
